interpretation: Original2015 Study Protocol describes the first five eligible families at each setting assigned intervention, then the next five comparison, with the same schedule across agencies. Authors nevertheless call the assignment random. No stochastic sequence or starting-order mechanism is described in the accessed protocol. Keep the provisional randomization-unverified hold; do not assert that an unreported random mechanism was impossible.
